description: This file defines the main route/component for a personal notes manager frontend, using Qwik framework. It manages state, handles user interactions, loads/saves notes from storage, and composes child components for note listing, editing, and UI top bar.

methods.name: filterNotesByTitle
methods.description: Filters a list of notes based on a search query, ignoring case and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: selectNote$
methods.description: Handles selection of a note by ID and persists the change.

methods.name: createNote$
methods.description: Creates a new empty note, adds it to the list, sets it as selected, and focuses its input.

methods.name: deleteNote$
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, updates selection if needed, and saves state.

methods.name: updateNote$
methods.description: Updates the title and body of a note by ID, updates timestamp, sorts notes, and saves state.

methods.name: onSearchInput$
methods.description: Updates the search signal based on user input.
